# Maison Aura Luxury Residences

> Luxury holiday apartments in Golem, near Durrës, on the coast of Albania. Guests ask for availability and a price on WhatsApp; there is no online booking.

- Location: Rruga Qemal Stafa, Golem, Albania (map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/GfPP4vG6PXEwPGCy9)
- Contact: WhatsApp +39 333 465 8601 (https://wa.me/393334658601)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/maisonaura_luxury_residences/
- Check-in from 14:00 local time
- Languages: English, Italian, Albanian, French
- Services: reception, daily housekeeping, garage parking available, Wi-Fi

## Residences

- One-Bedroom Residence: 60 m², 2–4 guests. Separate king bedroom, living room with sofa bed, street-facing terrace.
- Two-Bedroom Residence with Pool View: 90 m², 4–6 guests. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, terrace overlooking the pool.
- Two-Bedroom Residence with Side View: 90 m², 4–6 guests. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, side-view terrace.
